title: Advanced Worldgen Info Configuration Schema
description: Main configuration file for the AdvancedWorldgenInfo mod (config/awi/awi_common.json).

configVersion.description: Version of the configuration format. Do not edit by hand - an outdated value makes the mod rename the file to awi_common.json.bak and write a fresh default file.

spawnInfo.description: Which mobs biomes list as spawning in them. An empty whitelist turns biome mob spawns off completely, and then they are not even collected.

entities.description: Entities left out of the biome spawn lists, or with whitelist the only entities listed.

whitelist.description: If true, entities is a whitelist instead of a blacklist.

tooltipColors.description: Colors used when rendering tooltips. Changes take effect on restart.

text.description: Color of tooltip keys and labels. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

value.description: Color of tooltip values. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

error.description: Color of values belonging to an errored tooltip entry. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

branch.description: Color of the tree branch arrows. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

secondary.description: Color of secondary information after a value, such as the most likely value of a count. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

levels.description: Colors of enchantment level rows and their charts, used in order and repeated when there are more levels. Each is a vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid entry is skipped; an empty list falls back to the default.

logMoreStatistics.description: If true, logs more detailed statistics about the worldgen scan.

showInGameNames.description: If true, displays translated names instead of ids.

showCharts.description: Client-side. If true, a small chart of the distribution is drawn under numbers that have a most likely value.

showConfigConditionalBlocks.description: If true, shows blocks that a feature's code only places depending on the configuration it was given. Those blocks are wrong for some configurations, so they are hidden by default.

dimensions.description: Which dimensions are shown. Entries are dimension ids (minecraft:the_end) or dimension tags (#mymod:hidden); a leading ! hides what the entry matches. If any entry has no !, only matching dimensions are shown (whitelist); if every entry has !, all other dimensions are shown (blacklist). Empty shows everything. Tags are resolved on the server only.

dimensionIcons.description: Recipe-viewer category icon per dimension: dimension id -> item id, e.g. "minecraft:the_nether": "minecraft:netherrack". Dimensions not listed, and unknown items, use the default icon. Read on the client only.
